method.raw_decode: Python capstone x86/32 over each exported body range

vm_fault_direct_callers.post_call: add esp,0x14; iteration continues; EAX is not tested
stores EAX at [EBP-0x14], compares it with zero
stores EAX at [EBP-0xc], compares it with zero
immediately restores frame and RET; EAX is preserved
moves EAX to EDX and tests EDX

vm_object_copy.fact: tests +0x28 and +0x46 bit 0x10; fast path increments WORD +0x18 and writes output flag 1
calls vm_object_collapse, then conditionally reuses backing object after testing backing +0x1a and +0x28
allocates object, checks backing +0x20/+0x24, rewrites +0x20/+0x24 chain and updates WORD +0x18
writes output object/offset and output flag 0

vm_object_shadow.fact: zalloc then __vm_object_allocate; null allocation enters panic call
new +0x20 receives former object pointer; new +0x24 receives former offset; caller offset becomes 0 and object pointer becomes new object

vm_object_coalesce.fact: requires WORD +0x18 <= 1 and +0x28/+0x20/+0x1c all zero; otherwise unlocks and returns 0
removes matching pages, frees them under queue lock, extends +0x14 if needed, then returns 1

vm_fault_copy_entry.fact: vm_page_alloc_sequential failure unlocks, wakes a wait channel, sleeps, reacquires lock, and retries
source vm_page_lookup returning zero reaches panic
copies page, enters pmap mapping, activates page under queue lock, clears busy bit and wakes waiters

vm_map_copy_entry.fact: calls vm_object_copy, tests output flag, and conditionally sets entry bits 0x40 and 0x08
output-copy path deallocates prior object then pmap_copy; nonzero WORD +0x28 path invokes vm_fault_copy_entry

vm_map_fork.fact: calls lock_write on parent, increments parent +0x4c, then pmap_create(0)
calls vm_object_copy, tests output flag, marks flags, deallocates prior object and calls pmap_copy
nonzero child entry WORD +0x28 path calls vm_fault_copy_entry
calls lock_done on parent then returns child map pointer in EAX

vm_map_deallocate.fact: interlocks +0x34, decrements +0x30, and returns only when pre-decrement value remains positive
otherwise lock_write, vm_map_delete(full map range), pmap_destroy, then zfree
